result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but there are a few visual issues: the third 'Fastest near you' card is cut off at the right edge (acceptable if horizontally scrollable, but the truncation looks abrupt), and the last restaurant card at the bottom is clipped by the bottom navigation, suggesting a missing bottom padding.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' card in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge with its name truncated mid-word.
issues.suggestion: If this is an intentional horizontal scroll carousel, consider adding a subtle fade or partial peek of the next card so truncation looks intentional; otherwise ensure the full card name is visible.

issues.description: The second card in 'Popular right now' is clipped by the bottom navigation bar with no visible spacing, cutting off its image and hiding the restaurant details (name, rating, delivery info).
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable content area equal to the height of the bottom navigation bar so full cards and their details are visible when scrolled.

issues.description: The horizontal category chips row (All, Pizza, Sushi...) shows a partially cut-off chip at the right edge with no visual affordance indicating more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade-out gradient or slight edge peek to signal the row is horizontally scrollable.
